import sys, random, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)

toks = ['a','b']
def score(atoms):
    tables = [m.make_monitor('endswith', list(p), toks)[0] for p in atoms]
    return m.product_reachable_count(tables, 2)

rng = random.Random(4)
best = 0; bestset = None
for restart in range(6):
    cur = [tuple(rng.choice(toks) for _ in range(16)) for _ in range(10)]
    cs = score(cur)
    for step in range(60):
        cand = list(cur)
        i = rng.randrange(10)
        p = list(cand[i])
        for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3)):
            p[rng.randrange(16)] = rng.choice(toks)
        cand[i] = tuple(p)
        s = score(cand)
        if s > cs:
            cur, cs = cand, s
    if cs > best:
        best, bestset = cs, cur
    print('restart', restart, 'score', cs, 'best', best)
print('BEST', best)
if bestset:
    print(json.dumps({'services': toks, 'rules': [{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'endswith','path':list(p)}} for p in bestset], 'queries': []}))
